watch.summary: The streamer gets surprisingly emotional watching 100 Thieves celebrate their esports tournament victory.

beats.what: Streamer watches the 100 Thieves esports team hugging after winning.
Streamer wonders out loud why he is feeling so emotional.
Streamer wipes his eye as a player thanks the fans in the footage.
The team lifts the trophy together in the video.
Streamer smiles and expresses how happy he is for the team.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Why am I feeling so emotional, bro?
watch.why: The clip focuses on a wholesome, empathetic reaction to an esports championship win rather than a joke. Without knowledge of or investment in the team, there is little comedic payoff for a casual viewer.
